clauses.current_legal_basis: 42 U.S.C. 15001 note (Ex. Ord. No. 12994 as amended by Ex. Ord. No. 13309 and Ex. Ord. No. 13446 sec. 5), U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; the rename carried into EO 12994 as restated by EO 13446 sec. 5
clauses.reason: Sec. 1 of this order ("The President’s Committee on Mental Retardation is hereby renamed the President’s Committee for People with Intellectual Disabilities.") renamed the committee. The renaming took effect when the order was signed on 2003-07-25 and no end is stated in the clause or elsewhere in the order. Its result is still the current text of the order it amended: EO 13446 sec. 5 restates EO 12994 so that the committee "renamed the President’s Committee for People with Intellectual Disabilities (Committee), is hereby continued in operation", and the U.S. Code note to 42 U.S.C. 15001 (release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09) prints EO 12994 "as amended by Ex. Ord. No. 13309, July 25, 2003, 68 F.R. 44851; Ex. Ord. No. 13446, § 5, Sept. 28, 2007, 72 F.R. 56176". Before the restatement the clause named the committee in the rename; after it the restated sec. 1 of EO 12994 repeats the new name, so the substance of the rename is preserved. EO 13446 sec. 5 (signed 2007-09-28, "This order shall be effective September 30, 2007.") further amended EO 12994 "to read as follows", restating the whole of EO 12994; under the owner ruling on strike-and-insert and restatement amendments (2026-10-21) this clause continues, amended, and the restatement is a later event; the reviewer should note that the restatement replaced the text of EO 12994 and changed the wording of this clause's subject.

clauses.current_legal_basis: 42 U.S.C. 15001 note (Ex. Ord. No. 12994 as amended by Ex. Ord. No. 13309 and Ex. Ord. No. 13446 sec. 5), U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09
clauses.reason: Sec. 2 instructs that EO 12994 be amended by deleting the words "mental retardation" and inserting "intellectual disabilities" throughout, except in the title, the first line of the preamble and section 1. The amendment was made when the order took effect on 2003-07-25 and has no end date of its own. Its effect survives in the current text of EO 12994, which as restated by EO 13446 sec. 5 reads in its preamble "in order to promote full participation of people with intellectual disabilities in their communities" and in sec. 3 refers to "intellectual disabilities"; the 42 U.S.C. 15001 note lists EO 13309 as an amending order of the printed text. The restatement by EO 13446 replaced the whole of EO 12994, so after 2007-09-30 the words come from the restated text rather than from this instruction alone, which is the strike-and-insert situation the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 treats as a continuing, amended clause. EO 13446 sec. 5 (signed 2007-09-28, "This order shall be effective September 30, 2007.") further amended EO 12994 "to read as follows", restating the whole of EO 12994; under the owner ruling on strike-and-insert and restatement amendments (2026-10-21) this clause continues, amended, and the restatement is a later event; the reviewer should note that the restatement replaced the text of EO 12994 and changed the wording of this clause's subject.

clauses.current_legal_basis: 42 U.S.C. 15001 note (Ex. Ord. No. 12994 as amended by Ex. Ord. No. 13309 and Ex. Ord. No. 13446 sec. 5), U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09
clauses.reason: Sec. 3 amends section 1 of EO 12994 by deleting the words "(the ‘‘Committee’’)" and adding after "responsibilities," the words naming the renamed committee. Its effect is that sec. 1 of EO 12994 calls the body the President’s Committee for People with Intellectual Disabilities. No end is stated. EO 13446 sec. 5 restated sec. 1 of EO 12994 with the same sentence, "The President’s Committee on Mental Retardation, with expanded membership and expanded responsibilities, and renamed the President’s Committee for People with Intellectual Disabilities (Committee), is hereby continued in operation", and the 42 U.S.C. 15001 note prints that text as current EO 12994 as amended by EO 13309. Before the restatement this clause supplied the words; after it the restated section carries the same words. EO 13446 sec. 5 (signed 2007-09-28, "This order shall be effective September 30, 2007.") further amended EO 12994 "to read as follows", restating the whole of EO 12994; under the owner ruling on strike-and-insert and restatement amendments (2026-10-21) this clause continues, amended, and the restatement is a later event; the reviewer should note that the restatement replaced the text of EO 12994 and changed the wording of this clause's subject.

clauses.current_legal_basis: 42 U.S.C. 15001 note (Ex. Ord. No. 12994 as amended by Ex. Ord. No. 13309 and Ex. Ord. No. 13446 sec. 5), U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09
clauses.reason: Sec. 4 amends section 2 of EO 12994 by inserting after "(5) The Secretary of Housing and Urban Development;" four members (Commerce, Transportation, the Interior and Homeland Security) and renumbering the former (6) through (9) as (10) through (13). No end is stated. EO 13446 sec. 5 restated sec. 2 of EO 12994 as a list of thirteen ex officio members in a different order, which includes the four secretaries this clause added: it names "(2) The Secretary of the Interior; (3) The Secretary of Commerce;" and "(7) The Secretary of Transportation;" and "(9) The Secretary of Homeland Security;" (as printed in the 42 U.S.C. 15001 note). The four secretaries this clause added therefore remain members, in different numbering, so the substance of the clause continues in amended form; the earlier text of the other members of EO 12994 is not in the evidence of this packet, so no claim is made about them, and the reviewer should note that the restatement replaced the clause's numbering and list. EO 13446 sec. 5 (signed 2007-09-28, "This order shall be effective September 30, 2007.") further amended EO 12994 "to read as follows", restating the whole of EO 12994; under the owner ruling on strike-and-insert and restatement amendments (2026-10-21) this clause continues, amended, and the restatement is a later event; the reviewer should note that the restatement replaced the text of EO 12994 and changed the wording of this clause's subject.

Sec. 5 says "The Committee is continued until September 30, 2005." The date is the stated end of this command and is recorded inclusive (the continuance runs through the end of 2005-09-30); on the exclusive reading it ended when that day began. Nothing in the order extends it. The committee was later continued by separate orders each with its own date and terms; EO 13446 sec. 1(g) (signed 2007-09-28, effective 2007-09-30) lists "President’s Committee for People with Intellectual Disabilities; Executive Order 12994, as amended" among the committees "continued until September 30, 2009", which is a new continuance by a later order and not an extension of this clause, which is why this clause is recorded as terminated on its own stated date while the committee itself continues under other commands.

research_rationale:
The held official Federal Register text (68 FR 44851, FR Doc. 03-19572, filed 2003-07-30) was read in full and is the order signed 2003-07-25 by President Bush: its heading is "Executive Order 13309 of July 25, 2003", and its five sections rename the President’s Committee on Mental Retardation, amend EO 12994 and continue the committee until 2005-09-30. The clause inventory of five sections was confirmed against the text and covers every operative sentence. Sections 1 to 4 are amending commands whose results are carried in the current text of EO 12994, which the 42 U.S.C. 15001 note (U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09) prints as amended by EO 13309 and EO 13446 sec. 5; EO 13446 restated EO 12994 effective 2007-09-30 and is attached as a later event to each of those clauses. Section 5 ended on its own stated date. The bounded searches named below (U.S. Code, eCFR and the Office of the Federal Register catalogue) were read for coverage: the U.S. Code search covers editions current through 2026-10-09, so a law enacted from 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 is not reflected; the catalogue and the number search of the held texts found no revocation, supersession or further amendment of EO 13309 itself.

savings.reason: EO 13309 contains no savings, exemption or transitional clause: its sections 1 to 5 rename a committee, amend EO 12994 and continue the committee until 2005-09-30, and it has no provision preserving pending actions or continuing a prior arrangement. The only later instrument that acts on it in the held evidence, EO 13446, restates EO 12994 and neither revokes EO 13309 nor preserves or reserves any right under it.
